facts.statement: Dr. Priya Patel is Founder & CEO of Maple Street Dental.
Maple Street Dental FY25 revenue was approximately $9 million.
Maple Street Dental runs 2 clinics with 14 chairs and employs 22 staff.
Maple Street Dental serves about 6,500 active patients.

leader_statements.speaker: Dr. Priya Patel
leader_statements.quote: Filling every hygiene chair is our number one priority this year

facts.statement: Maple Street Dental opened its Round Rock clinic in April 2026.
Maple Street Dental plans a third location in Cedar Park in 2027.
Reviews of Maple Street Dental mention long waits to rebook and unanswered calls at peak hours.
